Americas Experience Fairmont across Central America. Explore desert wonders, timeless monuments, bold skylines, souks, museums, and sun-soaked coastlines. DISCOVER DISCOVER Europe Discover Fairmont in Europe, where slow travel and layered discovery is rewarded. Follow grand boulevards and medieval lanes, museum mornings and café evenings, alpine air and coastal light, with each stop shaped by art, architecture, and local ritual. Delve into culture-rich cities, island, and rainforest escapes in both heritage locales and burgeoning hot spots, all with a deep sense of place.
